first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Person B
entities.identification: A person with short dark hair and narrow dark glasses, wearing a long black coat, a dark top, and black pants, with harnesses around the waist and legs.

entities.name: handgun group B
entities.identification: Two black handguns placed on either side of Person B's body; the one on the image-right subsequently rotates beside the legs and feet.

entities.name: rooftop surface
entities.identification: A grayish-green paved surface, with a granular surface and straight longitudinal and transverse seams visible in wider shots.
